mapper.select: SELECT c.app_id AS appRefId, c.open_app_id AS appId, c.access_key AS accessKey, c.secret_key AS secretKey, c.sign_algorithm AS signAlgorithm, c.need_sign AS needSign, c.notify_url AS notifyUrl, c.notify_params AS notifyParams FROM tab_app_config c INNER JOIN tab_app a ON a.id = c.app_id INNER JOIN tab_app_sync_domain_config d ON d.app_ref_id = c.app_id WHERE c.sync_mode = 'NOTIFY' AND d.sync_domain = #{dataType} AND d.sync_enabled = 1 AND a.status = 2000
